info.name: SF-476 - Hide Annual_GWP_Estimate_Year_1__c from Account - API Tests
info.description:
Postman collection for SF-476 API tests. Tests for hiding Annual_GWP_Estimate_Year_1__c field from Account records for non-admin users.

## Setup Instructions:
1. Import this collection into Postman
2. Create a new environment (or use existing Salesforce QA environment)
3. Set the following environment variables:
   - `sf_base_url`: https://arx--qa.sandbox.my.salesforce.com
   - `sf_api_version`: v60.0
   - `sf_access_token`: Your Salesforce access token (get via OAuth or JWT)
   - `sf_instance_url`: Your Salesforce instance URL
   - `account_id`: Account ID for Lead creation
   - `lead_id`: Lead ID for update operations

## Authentication:
This collection uses Bearer Token authentication. Obtain an access token via:
- OAuth 2.0 flow
- JWT Bearer Token flow
- Username/Password flow

## Test Scenarios:
- Verify custom__c field exists on Lead and Account
- Verify custom__c is inherited from Account on Lead creation
- Verify custom__c cannot be updated on Lead after creation
- Reject invalid custom__c values
